title: Architecture Intentions — start here
body:
Architecture Intentions is a design-time ooRexx planner. It discovers business scope, existing estates, capabilities, actors, policies, interconnect guarantees, compute/storage/deployment alternatives, costs, questions and risks. It does not own user intent discovery, source code truth, document records or deployment.

Current source: full v0.1-dev10 tree mirrored at packages/oorexx_architecture_intentions/ from the Library v0.1-dev9 archive, with a new NotNotes publication request class and test. Previous dev9 delta-only Git status is superseded. dev10 package SHA-256 493c2e98b2a04543bb3d6b9e50240c3254dab275024ff127a220ab8197afaa24.

No feature implies the whole Alchemy stack. Scope may be a legacy MySQL/flat-file site or RexxOS MU/MI network. Distinct NotNotes source authority is at packages/alchemy_notnotes/ (historical dev15 source), while the v0.6.2 NotNotes corpus is documentary.

Architecture policy and NotNotes document publication are independent gates. The new dev10 adapter only produces a detached publication REQUEST: no NotNotes document was written and no live deployment was admitted.
summary: Full dev10 archive source mirrored on Git; design-time architecture only, no document publication or deployment.
invariants: Architecture selection and review never authorize execution
Unknown qualification fails closed and remains visible
Each external component retains its own semantic and provenance authority

provenance.claim: Exact historical baseline; no new runtime acceptance
